title: 第1928章 请你做个昏聩又清醒的王爷第1927章 大大的问题小小的他
content_zh:
“做人当狠？”
宋成霖问出自己的疑惑。
陈观楼轻笑一声，“做人当刚柔并济，能屈能伸。该狠的时候当狠，该软的时候发发善心也没问题，前提是不得损害自己的利益。
人活一世，为权势，为钱财，为名为利为长生，终究都是为了自己！自己才是第一位！自己的利益才是最重要的！
别光看书，多看看人。那些当官的，为何反复强调为民请命，因为只要这么说了，并且反复地去说，就能获得名声。而名声是什么？是读书人在这个世上的通行证，是他们获取权势财富的基石！
一个当官的没了名声，离着进天牢也就不远了。所以你想了解一个人，不要光听他说什么，你得看他做什么，看看他的诉求是什么？说得多漂亮都没有用，只看他是不是在此事件中获取了利益。”
宋成霖若有所思，神情格外激动。
陈观楼继续说道：“那些想爬你床，想要引诱你的姑娘，以及她们背后的家族，所图什么？无非是想要嫁给你，成为人上人。他们的家族则是想靠上王府，抬升家族地位，获取更多的钱财和权势。对于这种人，你看着办就行。
你作为王爷，未来会遇到许许多多的诱惑，许许多多的算计。一味的软弱，会被人欺负死。一味的强硬，则会众叛亲离。实在是拿不准主意，就从利益角度去考虑。对方能从你得到什么好处，你能从对方身上得到什么好处？对于未来会有什么影响？”
宋成霖听完，重重点头，心中有所明悟。
他犹豫了一阵，终于鼓足勇气，问道：“父亲，我听闻有人议论祖母和母亲，说她们身为女子，为人狠辣无情，破坏纲常伦理，是王府的罪人。书上也说……”
“别管书上说什么，尽信书不如无书。我不跟你讲大道理，我只告诉你一个真相，凡是骂你祖母和母亲的，就两种人。”
宋成霖很是好奇，“哪两种？”
陈观楼竖起两根手指头，“第一种，没能从你母亲和祖母身上占到便宜的人。第二种，嫉妒！嫉妒你祖母的好命，嫉妒你母亲的好命，于是大肆诋毁。什么纲常伦理，什么夫妻之道，出发点全是性别。但凡换个性别，相信没人会叽叽歪歪。就连嫉妒，都要小心翼翼藏起来，生怕被发现。”
听完，宋成霖恍然大悟。
他仔细回想曾经听过的那些非议。确实，非议祖母和母亲的人，都是没能从王府占到便宜的人。他们眼中有着不加掩饰的嫉妒，想要取而代之的强烈欲望。
呵呵！
原来是没占到便宜啊！
他笑了起来。
对自己曾经的迷茫，感到可笑。

为了几个小人的言论，竟然纠结了这么长时间。他即将继承爵位，担任新一任璐王。王府的利益就是他的利益。
那些人想占王府的便宜，等于是占他的便宜。
做梦！
顿时，他心头发了狠。
下次再叫他遇上，他定要狠狠收拾那帮人。
“所以，祖母和母亲没有错，她们是对的？”他想得到肯定的答案。
陈观楼看着大儿子满眼求知欲，伸手捏捏对方的脸颊，婴儿肥，很好捏。
宋成霖撇过头，很不好意思。
陈观楼轻声告诉他，“对错得看从什么角度看待问题。从你的立场来说，你的祖母跟你母亲，那可太对了。她们做的一切，都是为了维护你的利益。从王府宗亲的角度来说，她们大错特错。世间之事，关于对错，很多时候因为立场的不同，从而会到得出完全相反的结论。所以，人们常说屁股决定脑袋，立场决定对错。但有的事情，只有对错没有立场。”
“比如？”
content_en:
"Being ruthless?"
Song Chenglin asked his doubts.
Chen Guanlou chuckled lightly, "You should be strong and soft at the same time, and be able to bend and stretch. Be ruthless when you should be ruthless, and be kind when you should be soft. It's okay, as long as you don't harm your own interests.
People live their lives for power, money, fame and fortune, and longevity. In the end, it is all for themselves! You are the first! Your own interests are the most important!
Don't just read books, read more people. Why do those officials repeatedly emphasize asking for orders for the people? Because as long as they say this and say it repeatedly, they can gain fame. And what is fame? It is the pass for scholars in this world and the cornerstone for them to gain power and wealth!
When an official loses his reputation, he is not far away from being imprisoned in heaven. So if you want to understand a person, don't just listen to what he says, you have to see what he does and what his appeal is? It doesn't matter how beautifully he says it, it just depends on whether he has benefited from this incident. "
Song Chenglin was thoughtful and looked particularly excited.
Chen Guanlou continued: "What do those girls who want to climb into your bed and seduce you, and the families behind them, want to do? They just want to marry you and become a master. Their families want to rely on the palace, enhance the family status, and obtain more money and power. For such people, you can do whatever you want.
As a prince, you will encounter many temptations and many calculations in the future. If you are blindly weak, you will be bullied to death. If you insist on being tough, the congregation will rebel. If you really can’t make up your mind, think about it from the perspective of interests. What benefits can the other party get from you, and what benefits can you get from the other party? What impact will it have on the future? "
After listening to this, Song Chenglin nodded heavily, with a clear understanding in his heart.
He hesitated for a while, and finally plucked up the courage to ask: "Father, I heard someone talking about my grandmother and mother, saying that as women, they were cruel and ruthless, broke the ethics of society, and were sinners of the palace. The book also said..."
"Don't worry about what the book says. It's better to believe in the book than to have no book at all. I won't tell you the truth. I will only tell you the truth. Anyone who scolds your grandmother and mother is just two kinds of people."
Song Chenglin was very curious, "Which two types?"
Chen Guanlou raised two fingers, "The first type is people who failed to take advantage of your mother and grandmother. The second type is jealousy! I am jealous of your grandmother's good life, jealous of your mother's good life, so I slander them. The starting point of all ethics and the way of husband and wife is gender. As long as the gender is changed, I believe no one will quibble. Even jealousy must be carefully hidden for fear of being discovered."
After listening, Song Chenglin suddenly realized.
He thought carefully about the criticisms he had heard. Indeed, those who criticized my grandmother and mother were the ones who failed to take advantage of the palace. There was undisguised jealousy in their eyes and a strong desire to replace him.
hehe!
It turns out that I didn’t get any advantage!
He laughed.
I feel ridiculous for how confused I was.
I have been struggling for so long over the remarks of a few villains. He is about to inherit the title and serve as the new King Lu. The interests of the palace are his interests.
Those people who wanted to take advantage of the palace were tantamount to taking advantage of him.
dream!
Suddenly, his heart became fierce.
Next time we meet him, he will deal with those people severely.
"So, my grandmother and my mother were not wrong, they were right?" He wanted a definite answer.
Chen Guanlou looked at his eldest son with eyes full of curiosity, and reached out to pinch his cheeks. He had baby fat and was easy to pinch.
Song Chenglin turned his head away, feeling embarrassed.
Chen Guanlou told him softly, "Right or wrong depends on how you look at the problem. From your point of view, your grandmother and your mother are so right. Everything they do is to protect your interests. From the perspective of the royal clan, they are totally wrong.. In matters of the world, regarding right and wrong, many times, due to different positions, we will reach completely opposite conclusions. Therefore, people often say that the butt determines the head, and the stance determines right and wrong. But for some things, there is only right and wrong but no position. "
"for example? "
